title: Nick Pope's death from cancer
summary: Michael Shermer tells of Nick Pope's death from cancer, about 2020s at United Kingdom, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: Elizabeth [snorts] um Weiss her you know her husband Nick Pope um died of cancer just a couple

plain: Michael Shermer, a researcher known for questioning these claims, said this on a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels. He says that a man named Nick Pope, the husband of a woman named Elizabeth Weiss, died of cancer in the United Kingdom sometime in the 2020s. He mentions it in passing and names no source.
